summary: Iteration 24 — Editable email templates (19-template registry) + refactor of every send_email(wrap(...)) call site to send_tpl(). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration24_emails.py (18 pytest cases, ALL PASSING) covering: list returns exactly the 19 expected keys with subject/title/body/cta_label/cta_url/label/group/vars/customised plus defaults and the 7 group list; member+partner+manager 403 on list; PUT sanitises <script> (bleach strips tag) + flips customised=true; PUT bad cta_url (javascript:) -> 400; PUT blank subject or blank body -> 400; PUT unknown key -> 404; PUT allows {{variable}}/http/mailto/relative cta_url; DELETE unknown key -> 404; DELETE resets customised to false; POST /test returns {ok,sent_to,message} (ok=false is EXPECTED for admin@buddilio.com because the Resend sandbox rejects it); override of password_reset persists through /api/auth/forgot-password and template still shows override; override of welcome + registration flow returns 2xx with no 500; /api/cron/payout-reminders 401 without secret, 200 with, and re-running the cron does NOT create duplicate (manager_id, ISO-week) rows in db.payout_reminders; /api/console/payout-reminder returns subject/intro/items/total/currency/schedule/next_send_at/already_sent_this_week and does NOT leak `values` or `html`; editing payout_reminder template subject changes the console preview subject and reset restores the exact original subject. Extra check via ad-hoc script: a staff account with staff_role='viewer' (no content:manage) gets 403 on GET /api/admin/email-templates. Playwright verified: admin-tab-emails opens the emails-panel; exactly 19 email-select-<key> buttons render across the 7 groups (Members, Bookings, Growth, Money, Organisers, Safety, Team); clicking email-select-welcome renders email-vars/email-subject/email-title/email-body/email-cta-label/email-cta-url/email-save/email-test/email-reset; Save flips the pill to show 'edited' + preview updates; Reset (window.confirm accepted) removes the badge and restores default 'Welcome to Buddilio'; every other admin tab still loads (pages, sections, guides, team, verification, photos, users, partners, events, payouts); homepage hero + /p/faq render; mobile 390px shows the emails panel cleanly.

issues: The left rail (template list) and right editor stack vertically as expected on mobile, but the list is not visually separated from the editor — selecting an email scrolls the page to keep the list on top and the editor pushed down. Consider a mobile-first accordion or hiding the list once a template is selected with a back-button. Not a bug; purely UX polish.

action_items: None blocking. Consider adding a Playwright/RTL smoke test for the reset flow that auto-accepts window.confirm so future refactors don’t regress the DELETE call.

OPTIONAL: EmailTemplates.reset() calls window.confirm() — which is fine, but the /test endpoint has no such guard and will send a real (or attempted) email on every click. If admins misclick a template with a placeholder-driven subject, they still get a filled sample. Consider a small confirm or a per-key rate-limit (currently no rate-limit).
critical_code_review_comments: Nice: send_tpl() correctly resolves overrides on every send (async DB read per call). If email volume grows, consider an in-memory cache keyed on `key` with a short TTL and invalidation on PUT/DELETE — today every email send does one extra Mongo round-trip.

safe_html() is applied to body but NOT to `title`, `subject`, `cta_label` or `cta_url` beyond a startswith allow-list. Subjects render in the email client — mostly harmless — but titles are wrapped into HTML via wrap(); an admin (or a compromised content:manage staff) can inject arbitrary HTML into `title` (e.g. `
The test_email_template endpoint has no rate limiting. A tight loop clicking the button hammers the provider (which will 429 or ban the domain). Add a 10s per-admin cooldown or a queue.

audit(user, 'email_template.update', 'email_template', key, {}) passes an empty diff — so audit rows can’t tell you what wording actually changed. Consider recording old_subject/new_subject at minimum.

list_email_templates does one Mongo round-trip per template inside a list comprehension (await email_template(k) for each of 19 keys). Prefer one `find({key: {$in: list(EMAIL_TEMPLATES)}}).to_list()` then merge in memory.

EmailTpl payload has no length caps. subject/title/body could be pushed to megabytes; Mongo will accept, provider will reject at send time. Add Field(max_length=...) caps (e.g. subject 200, title 200, body 20000).

sends still block on the provider in the request path for /auth/forgot-password, /auth/register etc. (send_tpl awaited inline). A slow Resend response stalls the user’s HTTP request. Consider asyncio.create_task for user-facing transactional sends where the caller doesn’t need to know success.
The cta_url whitelist accepts `http://` (not just https://). Downgrade attack surface if these ever templated into a mixed-content email client. Restrict to https/mailto/{{}}/relative.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all iteration-24 testids resolve on desktop + mobile; all regression tabs load; homepage + /p/faq unaffected)

seed_data_creation: None persistent. Every email_template override my tests wrote is reset in a try/finally (verified db.email_templates ends the run empty). No stray TEST_iter24_* users remain. Skyline Sessions (invited.vendor@example.com) confirmed still verification_status='pending' with 1 document.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 19 email templates are wired end-to-end. When testing the reset button in Playwright you MUST register `page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())` because EmailTemplates.reset() uses window.confirm(). Cron POST /api/cron/payout-reminders is idempotent per (manager_id, ISO week) — verified by two consecutive cron hits leaving one row per manager. Skyline Sessions must stay verification_status='pending' with 1 document — my tests did not touch verification queues.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial Playwright reset check appeared to fail because reset() triggers a window.confirm() dialog; adding page.on('dialog') to auto-accept made the reset succeed and the 'edited' badge disappear. Also cross-checked via curl DELETE /api/admin/email-templates/welcome which returned customised=false.
